triage.summary: KubeSolo pods are stuck in CrashLoopBackOff due to image pull failures from an invalid registry host.
triage.cause: The kubelet cannot pull images from an invalid registry host (registry.invalid), causing pods to fail startup and enter CrashLoopBackOff. This matches the 'Container runtime stuck or slow' knowledge entry where 'failed to pull image' indicates the container runtime is overloaded or the registry is unreachable.
